description: Pay-per-call LLM chat (Mistral Small 3.1 24B): Balanced multilingual model (140+ languages) for writing, reasoning and long inputs. No API key or account. POST JSON {"prompt": "..."} or OpenAI-style {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "..."}]}, optional "system", "max_tokens" (up to 1024), "temperature", "json": true. Up to about 20,700 characters of English in. Failed calls are not charged. Price: $0.01 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.
